insight: Acquired by music-creation platform Splice in 2025.
name: Kits AI
tagline: Studio-quality AI voice cloning and music tools for artists and producers.
description: Kits AI lets musicians clone or use studio-quality singing and speaking voices, convert vocals between voices, and run a suite of audio tools (stem splitting, mastering, vocal cleanup). Voice models are ethically licensed from artists with revenue-sharing rather than scraped. A free plan is available, with paid Starter, Producer, and Professional tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own artist-licensed voice models; no external LLM.

edge: Voice models are licensed directly from artists with revenue-share, not scraped — a rare ethics stance in voice cloning.
pros: Ethically licensed artist voices with payouts
Bundled stem split, mastering, vocal cleanup
Free plan plus tiered paid plans
cons: Some report robotic or inconsistent output
Now owned by Splice (2025) — roadmap may shift

references.title: Splice acquires AI-powered voice production platform Kits AI
